text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. When you set SMART goals, you also need to define milestones—important checkpoints that help you track progress along the way. Another key part is identifying deliverables, which are the tangible results or products you must complete. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. This means making sure everyone involved, from team members to clients, agrees on the goals and understands their role. When all these elements work together, your project is much more likely to succeed.
